NecromancerTalentBoneArmorBacklash.name: Backlash
NecromancerTalentBoneArmorBacklash.description: When Bone Armor expires, nearby enemy Heroes take damage equal to 12% of their maximum Health.

NecromancerTalentBoneArmorShackler.name: Shackler
NecromancerTalentBoneArmorShackler.description: While Bone Armor is active, nearby enemies are Slowed by 35% for 1 second. Basic Attacks against Heroes that are Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor by 2 seconds.

NecromancerTalentBoneArmorShade.name: Shade
NecromancerTalentBoneArmorShade.description: While Bone Armor is active, Xul evades all Basic Attacks, but increases the cooldown of Bone Armor by 10 seconds.

NecromancerTalentReapersToll.name: Reaper's Toll
NecromancerTalentReapersToll.description: Reduce the cooldown of Spectral Scythe by 2 seconds and its Mana cost by 15.

NecromancerTalentGrimScythe.name: Grim Scythe
NecromancerTalentGrimScythe.description: Increase Xul's Basic Attack damage by 15%. Each enemy hit by Cursed Strikes reduces its cooldown by 1 second, up to 12 seconds.

NecromancerTalentJailors.name: Jailors
NecromancerTalentJailors.description: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors. These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum. Quest: Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors. Reward: While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

NecromancerTalentHarvestVitality.name: Harvest Vitality
NecromancerTalentHarvestVitality.description: Cursed Strikes heals for 70% of the damage dealt to Heroes.

NecromancerTalentTragOulsEssence.name: Trag'Oul's Essence
NecromancerTalentTragOulsEssence.description: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore 0.5% of Xul's maximum Health and 0.2% of his maximum Mana.

NecromancerBoneArmorWallOfBonesTalent.name: Wall Of Bones
NecromancerBoneArmorWallOfBonesTalent.description: Increase the Shield amount of Bone Armor to 35% of Xul's maximum Health, and Xul gains 20 Spell Armor for its duration.

NecromancerHeroicAbilityPoisonNova.name: Poison Nova
NecromancerHeroicAbilityPoisonNova.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

NecromancerHeroicAbilitySkeletalMages.name: Skeletal Mages
NecromancerHeroicAbilitySkeletalMages.description: Vector Targeting Summon 4 Frost Mages in a line that attack nearby enemies for 47 damage a second and Slow them by 30% for 2 seconds. Last up to 15 seconds.

NecromancerTalentEchoesOfDeath.name: Echoes of Death
NecromancerTalentEchoesOfDeath.description: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

NecromancerTalentRapidHarvest.name: Rapid Harvest
NecromancerTalentRapidHarvest.description: Gain 5% Attack Speed for 3 seconds each time Cursed Strikes hits an enemy, up to 75%.

NecromancerTalentAmplifyDamage.name: Amplify Damage
NecromancerTalentAmplifyDamage.description: Increase the Root duration of Bone Prison by 0.25 seconds. Enemies Rooted by Bone Prison lose 25 Armor for 2 seconds.

NecromancerTalentDecrepify.name: Decrepify
NecromancerTalentDecrepify.description: Enemy Heroes that are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

NecromancerTalentWeaken.name: Weaken
NecromancerTalentWeaken.description: Enemy Heroes who are damaged by Cursed Strikes or Skeletal Warriors deal 35% less damage for 3 seconds.

NecromancerTalentBoneSpear.name: Bone Spear
NecromancerTalentBoneSpear.description: Deal 230 damage to enemies in a line.

NecromancerTalentAndarielsVisage.name: Andariel's Visage
NecromancerTalentAndarielsVisage.description: Poison Nova heals for 50% of the damage dealt and its duration is increased by 50%.

NecromancerTalentColdHandOfDeath.name: Cold Hand of Death
NecromancerTalentColdHandOfDeath.description: Increase the Slow of Frost Mages by 20%. Every 5th Spectral Scythe that hits enemy Heroes spawns a Frost Mage instead of a Skeletal Warrior at their location.

NecromancerTalentMortalWound.name: Mortal Wound
NecromancerTalentMortalWound.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Spectral Scythe receive 75% less healing for 4 seconds.

NecromancerTalentKalansEdict.name: Kalan's Edict
NecromancerTalentKalansEdict.description: Each time Skeletal Warriors deal damage, reduce the cooldown of Bone Armor and Xul's Heroic Ability by 1.5%.
